reviews.author: lishunyang12
reviews.body:
Follow-up from `lishunyang12`:

I prepared [commit `20cc23ae`](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni/commit/20cc23ae) on the `agent/minimax-h3-trtllm-default` branch.

It makes MiniMax H3 declare its packed-sequence contract, so the platform auto-selects dense BF16 `TRTLLM_ATTN` on supported datacenter Blackwell (SM100/SM103) when FlashInfer's trtllm-gen kernel is available. Workstation Blackwell (SM120/SM121), unsupported head dimensions, and mask-using paths retain their normal fallback. No Skip-Softmax or attention quantization is enabled by default.

Validation:
- `41 passed, 2 skipped`
- Ruff check/format and `git diff --check` passed
- Matched 4x B300 SM103 run: 1248x768, 209 frames, 50 steps, seed 1101, Ulysses4/Ring1/TP1, VAE tile4, regional compile
- One compile warmup excluded; steady-state results:
  - FA4: 83.854 s diffusion / 88.558 s wall
  - Dense BF16 TRTLLM: 71.990 s diffusion / 76.176 s wall
  - TRTLLM is 14.1% faster for diffusion and 14.0% faster end to end in this workload

The complete test data and reproduction scripts are in [vllm-omni-rankings/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/tree/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e):

- [FA4 E2E video](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/blob/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e/minimax_h3_t2va_fa4_4xb300_8p7s_50step.mp4)
- [TRTLLM dense BF16 E2E video](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/blob/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e/minimax_h3_t2va_trtllm_dense_bf16_4xb300_8p7s_50step.mp4)
- [Serve script](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/blob/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e/serve_b300.sh)
- [Curl T2VA request 1](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/blob/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e/curl_t2va.sh)
- [Offline A/B benchmark script](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/blob/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e/run_attention_ab.py)
- [README and exact environment/results](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni-rankings/blob/main/scripts/minimax_h3_trtllm_e2e/README.md)

The uploaded videos are combined packed-H3 optimization evidence rather than an isolated run of #5779 alone; the follow-up commit is ready to cherry-pick if desired.
